lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Reteach and varied practice: similar triangles and slope

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: These two examples show the same idea in two different formats.

items.prompt: A line passes through (1, 2). A slope triangle on the line has a horizontal leg (run) of 3 and a vertical leg (rise) of 2. A similar slope triangle further along the same line is 2 times as large. Which point also lies on the line?

steps: The base slope triangle shows a slope of 2/3.
Scaling the triangle by 2 gives a run of 6 and a rise of 4 from (1, 2).

items.prompt: A line has a slope of 3/4. A right triangle drawn along the line has a horizontal leg (run) of 12 units. What is the length of the vertical leg (rise)?

steps: Slope = rise/run, so rise = slope × run.
The vertical leg is 9 units long.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: Write the equation, in slope-intercept form, of the line through (-5, 13) and (-4, 12).
Identify the slope and y-intercept of the line y = -4x.

Relationship A: y = (7/2)x
Relationship B (proportional):
x: 2, 4, 6
y: 5, 10, 15
Which relationship has the greater rate of change (unit rate)?
choices: The rate of change cannot be determined from this information.
They have the same rate of change.

items.prompt: For the line y = (-1/4)x + 5, find y when x = 5.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A line has equation y = -6x - 7. Which of these equations represents a line parallel to it?
A line has equation y = -x + 5. Write the equation of the line through (-1, -8) that is parallel to this line.
A plant's height is given by H = 1w + 4, where H is the height in centimeters and w is the number of weeks since it was measured. What does the slope represent in this context?
choices: The plant was 1 centimeters tall when it was first measured.
The plant grows 1 centimeters per week.
The plant was 4 centimeters tall when it was first measured.
The plant grows 4 centimeters per week.

items.prompt: A plant's height is given by H = 9w + 20, where H is the height in centimeters and w is the number of weeks since it was measured. What does the y-intercept represent in this context?
choices: The plant was 9 centimeters tall when it was first measured.
The plant grows 20 centimeters per week.
The plant was 20 centimeters tall when it was first measured.
The plant grows 9 centimeters per week.

items.prompt: Find the slope of the line through (-8, 10) and (6, 18).
